_meta.description: Real-world end-of-season player awards, for comparison against the model's Q2 per-(league x season) MVP picks. Researched and source-verified against authoritative pages (Wikipedia, BBC Sport, PFA). Player names follow the FBref-cleaned convention used in the dataset so name-equality matching works. Schema: each entry is {winner, award, source} (winner null where no award was given).
caveats: Award definitions differ by league. PL = PFA Players' Player of the Year (voted by professionals). La Liga = La Liga Best Player (LaLiga Awards). Serie A = Serie A MVP (Lega Serie A, since 2018-19) / Serie A Footballer of the Year for 2017-18. Ligue 1 = UNFP Ligue 1 Player of the Year. Bundesliga = German Footballer of the Year, a calendar-year, German-nationality award (voted by journalists) used as a proxy: its winners can play OUTSIDE the Bundesliga (e.g. Kroos/Gundogan at Real Madrid/Man City), so it is NOT a strict Bundesliga-league award.
Calendar-year awards (Ballon d'Or, German Footballer of the Year) are mapped to the season that ENDS in that year (e.g. 2017-2018 -> 2018 award).
2019-2020: the Ballon d'Or was cancelled (COVID-19) and the UNFP Ligue 1 ceremony was cancelled (season curtailed).
